content.title: Film Recommendation: Parasite
content.body:
## Summary
Parasite, directed by Bong Joon-ho, is a masterpiece that brilliantly shifts genres while delivering sharp social commentary.

## Notable Features
- First non-English film to win Best Picture at the Academy Awards
- Examines class disparity in modern South Korea
- Seamlessly blends dark comedy, thriller, and drama elements
- Meticulous visual storytelling with architectural symbolism

## Notes
Bong Joon-ho crafts a narrative that begins as a clever con story before transforming into something far more complex and unsettling. The film's examination of social inequality is enhanced by its precise visual language, with the contrasting homes of the wealthy and working-class families serving as physical manifestations of the social divide.
